name: Protego
long_description: Protego helps companies recover lost revenue from chargebacks. The company automates chargeback management and dispute processes. It provides real-time monitoring, reporting, and analytics on chargeback information for providing valuable insights into fraudulent consumer behavior.
one_liner: We help companies recover lost revenue from chargebacks

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Pablo Rojas, co-founder and CEO. Prior to founding Protego, Pablo led Rappi Bank's Onboarding and Know Your Customer (KYC) for Latam and helped structure the company's chargeback reconciliation process. He also co-founded a non-profit organization that improves the living conditions of vulnerable social sectors, victims of extreme poverty and armed conflict in Colombia.
